title: Game Party 2 (Nintendo Wii, 2008)  Family Fun -Brand New Sealed-
descriptionText:
Get ready for a night of fun with Game Party 2 for Nintendo Wii. This game is perfect for family gatherings and parties with friends. With a wide variety of mini-games to choose from, you'll never run out of exciting things to play.

Released in 2008, this game is rated E for Everyone and is part of the popular Game Party Series. Published by Midway Home Entertainment, Game Party 2 features action and adventure genres, making it a great addition to any gamer's collection. So, gather your friends and family and get ready to party with Game Party 2!
